name: ZX_REPORTING_CODES_B
description: This table stores the tax reporting codes, which are unique codes for tax reporting purposes.

columns.name: REPORTING_CODE_ID
columns.description: Tax reporting code identifier

columns.name: EXCEPTION_CODE
columns.description: Not currently used

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_FROM
columns.description: Effective from date

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_TO
columns.description: Effective to date

columns.name: RECORD_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate whether the record is migrated, seeded or defined by the user

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: PROGRAM_APP_NAME
columns.description: Application identifier of last concurrent program to update this record

columns.name: PROGRAM_NAME
columns.description: Program identifier of last concurrent program to update this record

columns.name: PROGRAM_LOGIN_ID
columns.description: Login user identifier of last concurrent program to update this record

columns.name: REPORTING_CODE_CHAR_VALUE
columns.description: Column to store alphanumeric value for the reporting code

columns.name: REPORTING_CODE_DATE_VALUE
columns.description: Column to store date value for the reporting code

columns.name: REPORTING_CODE_NUM_VALUE
columns.description: Column to store numeric value for the reporting code

columns.name: REPORTING_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Reporting type identifier of this reporting code

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: VALUE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of tax boxes such as Taxable Box, Non Recoverable Tax Box etc.

columns.name: SIGN_FLAG
columns.description: Plus or minus sign to be associated with the box numbers.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
